A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IGD research work. All 14 pages, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E, are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original token-decisiveness analyses, IGD recommendation experiments and component ablations, including additional LLaMA3-8B results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains the original token analyses and recommendation experiments, including the revised ablation results in Table 3 and generalizability results in Appendix E.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain the same token-decisiveness computation, zero-IG token downweighting during tuning and IG-weighted beam-search scoring. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate next-item recommendation on the same four Amazon domains: CDs, Games, Toys and Books. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains GRU4Rec, SASRec, BIGRec and D3, with Pos, CFT and IGD evaluated on the same LLM4Rec backbones. The ablation comparators and Appendix E comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, preprocessing, all-ranking evaluation, HR/NDCG at 5 and 10, model configurations and training settings match across versions. The Table 3 score revisions are not accompanied by a reported protocol change.

E4.justification: Table 3 revises evidence about tuning and decoding contributions on Games and the no-component control on Books. The Games HR@10 advantage of full IGD over removing decoding reweighting shrinks from 0.0053 to 0.0004. Ablation variants and the analyses in Appendices C–D remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Run/seed disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged. The Table 3 revisions introduce no confidence intervals, significance tests or other statistical estimation information.

E6.justification: Ten Table 3 values change. In Games, ordered as N@5, N@10, H@5, H@10, IGD changes from (0.0520, 0.0610, 0.0711, 0.0991) to (0.0518, 0.0598, 0.0705, 0.0946); w/o wd changes from (0.0515, 0.0593, 0.0700, 0.0938) to (0.0514, 0.0594, 0.0695, 0.0942). Books w/o Both changes N@10 from 0.0227 to 0.0228 and H@10 from 0.0314 to 0.0315. Other table and figure results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The entropy and information-gain definitions, loss equations and decoding equations are unchanged. No formal assumption, proof or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: information-gain-based token decisiveness, tuning and decoding reweighting, and improved recommendation accuracy across datasets and backbones.

C2.justification: The interpretation that tuning contributes more than decoding is retained. The explanations of token bias, the decoding-bias versus accuracy trade-off in Section 5.4, and the IG-only scoring limitation in Section 7 are unchanged.

D1.justification: The code-access statement and implementation disclosures are unchanged, including Appendix B's optimizer, batch size, stopping rule and hyperparameter searches, and Section 5.5's QLoRA settings.

R1.justification: The reference list and research positioning are unchanged, including Section 6's comparisons with D3, ghost-token bias mitigation and other token-reweighting approaches.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 16 Jun 2025 to v2 dated 19 Sep 2025. The prose, terminology, headings and section/appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–5 retain their designs, captions and placements. The main-text and appendix layouts are retained; Table 3 changes only numerical entries.

improvement.justification: v2 resolves Table 2/Table 3 inconsistencies for full IGD on Games and the unweighted D3 control on Books. This improves the ablation report's internal consistency while preserving the main results and qualitative conclusions. The quality gain is limited to these reporting revisions.
